children: Contract with Entities under the Israeli Ministry of Transport leveraging Ituran's Big Data platform, analyzing anonymized data from over one million vehicles to guide national transport policy

(Nasdaq: ITRN), a global leader in vehicle telematics and OEM connectivity solutions, today announced that it has been awarded a contract to provide entities of the Israeli Ministry of Transport (MOT) with a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution for monitoring live traffic behavior across Israel's main roads. The contract spans up to four years and is valued at over NIS 21 million (approximately US$7 million), of which the first year, amounting to NIS 5 million (approximately $1.7 million), is guaranteed.
The service is delivered through Ituran's proprietary

platform, analyzing anonymized data from more than one million vehicles, representing approximately one quarter of all vehicles in the country1. The platform provides macro-level insight into traffic and driver behavior across Israel's road network, which entities under the Ministry of Transport will use to guide policy and future road investment.
Eyal Sheratzky, co-CEO of Ituran, commented,

"This project marks an important step in validating the value of our Big Data platform beyond our core telematics and stolen vehicle recovery services. Our three decades of experience together with the aggregated insights from over one million connected vehicles, enables us to support governments invest in safer, smarter and more efficient roads. For Ituran, it launches a new, recurring revenue stream built on data assets we already own. We believe this is a strong example of how our decades of telematics expertise and unique data assets can serve both the public sector and the broader mobility ecosystem."

"Being awarded our first multi-year commercial contract is a significant advance in our Big Data initiative, one of three new growth initiatives announced earlier this year. These also include IturanMob, our shared mobility management platform recently launched in the United States, and our platform for monetizing carbon credits for electric vehicle drivers."

Ituran is a leader in the mobility technology field, providing value-added location-based services, including a full suite of services for the connected car. Ituran offers Stolen Vehicle Recovery, fleet management, as well as mobile asset location, management and control services for vehicles, cargo and personal security for the retail and insurance industries and car manufacturers. Ituran is the largest OEM telematics provider in Latin America. Its products and applications are used by customers in over 20 countries. Ituran is also the founder of the Tel Aviv-based DRIVE startup incubator to promote the development of smart mobility technology.

Ituran's subscriber base has been growing significantly since the Company's inception to over 2.7 million subscribers using its location-based services with a market-leading position in Israel and Latin America. Established in 1995, Ituran has approximately 2,800 employees worldwide, with offices in Israel, Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, Ecuador, Colombia, India, Canada and the United States.
